trip.title: Baltimore → Philadelphia
trip.subtitle: Niece's birthday weekend — Christmas market, a great lunch, and a Fishtown dinner

homeBases.area: Center City (Windsor Suites, Ben Franklin Pkwy)

trip.notes: Amtrak Baltimore → Philadelphia 30th St (~1 hr), then walk / SEPTA / Uber — no car. Center City base with the Christmas market on foot; Fishtown dinner is a ~15 min Uber. Weekend timing so Kalaya's brunch/lunch is available. Two options per meal — pick by mood; ⭐ = needs a reservation. It's the niece's birthday, so the Fishtown dinner is the centerpiece.

days.label: Arrive · Saturday
days.title: Market lights and a birthday dinner

beats.text: Amtrak from Baltimore to Philadelphia 30th St (~1 hr), Uber/SEPTA to the Windsor Suites (Ben Franklin Pkwy), drop bags.
Central lunch, pick by mood: ⭐ Vernick Fish (upscale seafood, ~5 min from the hotel — Resy) or Middle Child (cult sandwiches, walk-in). Fallbacks: Parc or Reading Terminal.

Christmas Village at LOVE Park + City Hall (~5 min walk). Go mid-afternoon and stay as it lights up ~4:30 — mulled wine, German stalls, the Dilworth Park ice rink. Detour to the free Macy's Christmas Light Show + Dickens Village (old Wanamaker building, on the hour).
Birthday dinner in Fishtown (~15 min Uber; pick one, all ⭐ book-ahead): Kalaya (Southern Thai, Michelin), Suraya (Lebanese, stunning room), or Laser Wolf (Solomonov skewer grill, set-price, festive).

days.fuel: Coffee near the market: Elixr or Vernick Coffee Bar. In Fishtown before dinner: the La Colombe flagship.

days.label: Depart · Sunday
days.title: Brunch, one last thing, home

beats.text: Brunch before the train, pick one: Reading Terminal Market (DiNic's roast pork, Beiler's donuts) or K'Far (Solomonov's Israeli café — best if dinner wasn't Israeli). Fallback: Parc.
One easy thing if there's time: a Rittenhouse Square stroll or the Barnes Foundation (indoor, near the hotel). Then Amtrak home from 30th St.

days.fuel: Last coffee: K'Far, or Old City Coffee inside Reading Terminal.

reservations.name: Amtrak — Baltimore → Philadelphia
reservations.address: Baltimore Penn Station, 1515 N Charles St, Baltimore, MD 21201
reservations.notes: ~1 hr to 30th St. Book early for the good fare; 3 seats together.

reservations.name: Amtrak — Philadelphia → Baltimore
reservations.address: William H. Gray III 30th St Station, 2955 Market St, Philadelphia, PA 19104
reservations.notes: Return. Pick an afternoon departure after brunch.

reservations.name: The Windsor Suites
reservations.notes: 1 night. 1-BR suite for 3 (separate bedroom + sofa bed + kitchenette). ~5 min walk to the Christmas Village.

reservations.name: Vernick Fish — Sat lunch (option A)
reservations.notes: Resy recommended for Sat lunch. Walk-in alt: Middle Child. Fallbacks: Parc, Reading Terminal.

reservations.name: Kalaya — birthday dinner (option A)
reservations.notes: Resy. Southern Thai, Michelin. Fishtown. Pick ONE of the three dinners.

reservations.name: Suraya — birthday dinner (option B)
reservations.notes: Resy. Lebanese, gorgeous room, celebratory. Fishtown.

reservations.name: Laser Wolf — birthday dinner (option C)
reservations.notes: Resy. Solomonov set-price skewer grill, festive for a group. Book ~2–4 wks out.

reservations.name: Christmas Village at LOVE Park + City Hall
reservations.address: LOVE Park, Arch St & N 15th St, Philadelphia, PA 19102
reservations.notes: Free. Runs Nov 21–Dec 27, 2026. Best after dark (~4:30). Ice rink + market at Dilworth Park next door.

reservations.name: Macy's Christmas Light Show + Dickens Village
reservations.notes: Free; light show on the hour. ~5 min from the market.

reservations.name: Barnes Foundation (optional Sun)
reservations.notes: Optional indoor hour near the hotel; timed tickets.

checklists.name: Book these early
items: Amtrak both ways (3 seats together) — book early for fare
Birthday dinner — Kalaya / Suraya / Laser Wolf (Resy, pick one, ~2–4 wks out)
Confirm Kalaya weekend hours if using it
Barnes Foundation timed tickets (only if doing it)

items: Warm coat + layers, hat & gloves — December market is cold
Birthday card / gift for the birthday girl
Rideshare + SEPTA app; Amtrak tickets on phone
